title: Tame Factorization Property I
summary: We introduce the \emph{tame factorization property} for triples of Fréchet spaces: a triple $(E,G,F)$ has the tame factorization property, denoted by $(E,G,F) \in \mathfrak{TF}$, if there exists a nondecreasing function $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that every operator from $E$ to $F$ factoring through $G$ is $S$-tame. We give a complete characterization of $\mathfrak{TF}$ in terms of operator seminorm estimates.
